title: Evaluating AI Agents for Industrial-Level Chip Floorplanning: A Framework and Empirical Study
abstract: arXiv:2611.12048v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Floorplanning is an early step in turning a logical circuit into a physical chip: it positions large circuit modules and constrains the space available for subsequent logic placement and wiring. These decisions affect congestion and timing, but their physical consequences emerge through downstream implementation. For AI agents, the task requires translating engineering constraints into spatial decisions whose quality cannot be judged by successful tool execution alone. We present an evaluation framework that connects submitted layouts to a prescribed downstream implementation flow, checks geometric validity, measures physical quality, and reports resource use. translated_title: 评估面向工业级芯片布局规划的AI智能体：一个评估框架与实证研究
translated_abstract: 布局规划是将逻辑电路转化为物理芯片的早期步骤：它确定大型电路模块的位置，并为后续的逻辑布局与布线约束可用空间。这些决策会影响拥塞和时序，但其物理后果需通过下游实现流程才能显现。对于AI智能体而言，该任务需要将工程约束转化为空间决策，而其质量无法仅凭工具是否成功执行来判断。我们提出了一个评估框架，将提交的布局与规定的下游实现流程相连接，检查几何有效性，测量物理质量，并报告资源使用情况。在一个工业设计上（其99个宏模块占据固定L形布局区域约71%的面积），我们将我们的专用系统Nova-SI与通用工程智能体以及仅限文件访问的智能体进行比较，获得了39个布局对象的完整物理测量数据（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个将AI智能体生成的芯片布局与规定的下游实现流程相连接的评估框架，并在99个宏模块的工业级L形布局设计上实证比较了专用系统Nova-SI与通用工程智能体的布局物理质量。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an evaluation framework that links AI agent-generated chip floorplans to a prescribed downstream implementation flow and empirically compares the specialized system Nova-SI with general-purpose engineering agents on an industrial L-shaped design containing 99 macros.
